files.artifacts/api-server/src/lib/buildableEn: new exported `withholdUnverifiedAreaFigure(derived, atomPromotion)` + `AREA_FIGURE_WITHHELD_DISCLOSURE`. Deletes the two properties from the feature's properties when `isEnvelopeAtomVerified(atomPromotion)` is false; replaces a drawn envelope's disclosure with the withholding sentence; leaves an empty result's own decline words; returns the SAME reference when the figure is already absent or the atom is verified (idempotent). Also makes the pre-existing `alreadyAgrees` comparison in reconcileWithAtomEnvelope read the now-optional property safely (behaviour identical: `typeof x === 'number'` was already implied by `Math.round(x)` being finite).

hoists the atom's promotion fields into one `atomPromotion` const (was an inline literal passed to reconcile) and applies the new step LAST: `const derived = withholdUnverifiedAreaFigure(reconciled, atomPromotion)`. `atomReconciled` still compares the RECONCILE result against `rawDerived`, so `derivePath` is unchanged for every existing case.

`buildableAreaSqFt` / `buildableAreaPct` become OPTIONAL on `BuildableEnvelopeProps`, with the P-304 doc comment stating that absence is the withheld state and `withholdUnverifiedAreaFigure` is its only writer. No producer inside derive.ts changes: a raw `deriveBuildableEnvelope` result still always carries both.
